title: PBMC Isolation from Buffy Coat
author: Bulent Arman Aksoy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qu2dwye

steps.title: Prepare Isolation Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the isolation buffer and store in the fridge.

substeps.instruction: Mix 500 ml PBS w/o Mg and Ca (Fisher Bioreagents, BP2944-100), 0.5 g BSA (Fisher Scientific, BP9703-100), and 2 ml 0.5 M EDTA (Fisher Scientific, BP2482500).
Sterile filter the buffer using EMD Millipore™ Stericup™ Sterile Vacuum Filter Units (0.22 um).

steps.title: Prepare Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Combine the buffy coat with isolation buffer in falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Fill four 50-ml falcon tubes with 15 ml isolation buffer each.
Cut the buffy coat and place it into another 50 ml falcon tube.
Split the 50 ml blood between the four 50-ml falcons containing isolation buffer, ensuring each tube has ~30 ml blood/buffer mix.

steps.title: Perform Density Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Underlay separation medium and centrifuge to isolate the buffy layer.

substeps.instruction: Using a 10 ml pipet, gently underlay 14 ml of Corning™ cellgro™ Lymphocyte Separation Medium below the blood in each tube.
Centrifuge at 800 X g for 25 min at RT with soft deceleration.

steps.title: Collect Buffy Layer
steps.instruction: Transfer the isolated buffy layer to new tubes.

substeps.instruction: Use a 10 ml pipet to transfer the cloudy buffy layer to a fresh tube.
Wait 1-2 mins for more of the buffy layer to form and transfer that to the fresh tube as well.

steps.title: Wash PBMC Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the collected cells with cold isolation buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add cold isolation buffer to each tube to reach a final volume of 40 ml.
Mix by gently inverting the tubes a few times.
Centrifuge at 500 X g for 10 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Pool and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Combine the washed pellets into a single sample.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant into a bleach-filled container, leaving ~5 ml of liquid.
Combine the pellet from all tubes into one tube.
Increase the volume to 40 ml by adding isolation buffer.

steps.title: Count Cells
steps.instruction: Perform cell counting using a Countess™ II Automated Cell Counter (Thermo Fisher Scientific, AMQAX1000).

substeps.instruction: Take 10 ul from the sample and mix with 90 ul of PBS (1:10 dilution).
Mix 10 ul of the diluted sample with 10 ul of Trypan Blue.
Load 10 ul of the mixture into the cell counter chamber for counting.

steps.title: Final Processing
steps.instruction: Proceed with the desired T cell isolation kit or freeze the PBMC cells.
